jobs.title: Analytics Engineer, Forecasting & Revenue Intelligence
jobs.description: Job Requisition ID # 26WD101381 Position Overview Autodesk’s worldwide sales organization depends on its forecast, pipeline, targets and reporting. This role builds the data models behind them. As an Analytics Engineer on the Forecasting & Revenue Intelligence team, you turn sales, subscription and hierarchy data into tested, documented models that analysts and sales leaders can trust, covering what customers bought, who owns which accounts and how the sales organization looked on any given date. You will work in SQL and dbt on Snowflake, and you will work closely with the people who use your models. This is a hands-on role on a new team, and you will own what you ship. Location: United States (remote). Central or Eastern time zone preferred. Organization: Revenue Operations Responsibilities Build and maintain dbt models on Snowflake that bring Salesforce, subscription, billing, hierarchy and forecast data into a clean, documented form Model data for analysis: a clear grain, stable keys, and definitions consistent with the shared metric dictionary Keep history so any published number can be reproduced as it stood on the day it went out Maintain the mapping between accounts, territories, sellers and the sales hierarchy as the organization changes Reconcile the data to Salesforce and to Finance, and find the cause when they disagree Build the datasets behind the weekly forecast pack, business reviews and leadership dashboards Add tests and monitoring for freshness, completeness and accuracy, and fix what breaks Explain data issues and trade-offs to sales and finance partners in plain terms, and agree on a fix with them Work in version control with code review and continuous integration Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in a technical or quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience 3+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering or BI development, building models other people depended on Dbt in production, with tests and documentation as part of how you work Strong SQL, including window functions and incremental models, in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake Working knowledge of the Salesforce data model: accounts, opportunities, line items and ownership Ability to explain a data problem to a non-technical stakeholder and reach a decision together Preferred Qualifications Dbt snapshots or slowly changing dimensions for point-in-time reporting Python for transformation or orchestration, with Airflow or similar Enterprise software or SaaS commercial data: subscriptions, renewals, territories, and direct and partner routes to market Revenue intelligence platforms such as Clari, Gong or Aviso, and BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Sigma Experience as an early hire jobs.title: Data Engineer II - Remote
jobs.description: About the Company The client is a US-based pharmaceutical organization investing in modern data infrastructure to support analytics, reporting, and business decision-making. The organization is developing a scalable data platform to serve research, commercial, and operational teams, with a focus on reliable data pipelines and infrastructure. About the Role The organization is seeking a Senior Data Engineer for an initial 12-month contract, with strong potential for extension. This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates based in the United States who can work during US business hours. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that support business analytics and downstream applications. You will work with modern data platforms, cloud technologies, and ETL/ELT processes to deliver reliable, high-quality datasets. You will also collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders while contributing to data architecture, performance optimization, governance, and documentation in a pharmaceutical environment. Key Responsibilities •Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, transform, and deliver data across the organization. •Develop and optimize data models that support analytics, reporting, and downstream applications. •Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes using modern data tools and technologies. •Maintain data quality, integrity, and governance across pipelines in accordance with the needs of a regulated pharmaceutical environment. •Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver reliable datasets. •Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve the performance and reliability of existing data infrastructure. •Contribute to architectural decisions related to data storage, processing, and platform tooling. •Document data flows, pipelines, and technical decisions to support audit, governance, and compliance requirements. Required Qualifications •Proven experience as a Senior Data Engineer building and maintaining production data pipelines at scale. •Strong SQL skills and experience with modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or similar technologies. •Experience with ETL/ELT tools and orchestration frameworks such as Airflow, dbt, or comparable solutions. •Strong Python programming skills or equivalent programming experience. •Experience working with cloud data platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). •Strong understanding of data pipeline development, data transformation, and production data infrastructure. •Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders. •Must be based in the United States and available to work US business hours. Preferred Qualifications •Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, or another regulated industry. •Experience building and maintaining real-time or streaming data pipelines using technologies such as Kafka or Kinesis. •Familiarity with data governance and compliance frameworks relevant to regulated environments. Compensation & Contract Details •Contract Duration: Initial 12 months, with strong potential for extension. •Compensation: Competitive hourly rate, dependent on experience (DOE). •Work Arrangement: 100% remote. •Location Requirement: US-based candidates only. Employment Details •Job Title: Senior Data Engineer •Company: Client is a US-based pharmaceutical organization; company name not specified. •Employment Type: Contract •Contract Duration: 12 months initially •Work Location: Remote within the United States •Salary: Competitive hourly rate, based on experience

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong><br>As a Data Engineer on the Data Science &amp; Analytics team, you'll build the foundation that lets analytics scale across Anthropic. You'll partner with Engineering, Product and other teams to turn raw data into reliable metrics, reporting and insights, and you'll make sure teams have accurate metrics for our consumer products from idea to launch. You'll also lead your own projects that make self-serve insights possible, so teams can make data-driven decisions.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Understand, and where possible anticipate, the data needs of partner teams, and translate them into data models, reporting and technical requirements</p> </li> <li> <p>Define, build and manage key dbt pipelines that turn and share insights across the company</p> </li> <li> <p>Build foundational data products, dashboards and tools that let self-serve analytics scale</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with stakeholders to define and materialize metrics and analysis for new and evolving consumer products</p> </li> <li> <p>Shape Product teams' roadmaps from a data systems perspective</p> </li> <li> <p>Become an expert in our data models and data architecture</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>You may be a good fit if you have</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Significant experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar Data Science &amp; Analytics role, ideally partnering with Product leads to build and report on company-wide metrics</p> </li> <li> <p>A passion for Anthropic's mission of building helpful, honest and harmless AI</p> </li> <li> <p>Expertise building multi-step ETL jobs with tools like dbt, plus experience with workflow tools like Airflow and version control through GitHub</p> </li> <li> <p>Expertise in SQL and Python for turning data into accurate, clean data models</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building reporting and dashboards in tools like Hex that serve multiple cross-functional teams</p> </li> <li> <p>A bias for action, and a sense of when "good enough" beats perfect</p> </li> <li> <p>An end-to-end mindset: you take ownership of solving a problem fully, even when that means picking up work beyond your usual scope</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfort with ambiguity, and a habit of creating clarity and forward progress</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience using AI to scale your own productivity and your team's without lowering the quality of the work</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Strong candidates may also have</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience building a data engineering (or similar) function from the ground up in an early-stage or fast-growing environment</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$320,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$405,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study:&nbsp;</strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong>&nbsp;We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.&nbsp; Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from&nbsp;@anthropic.com&nbsp;email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit&nbsp;<u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/careers</a></u>&nbsp;directly for confirmed position openings.</p> <h2><strong>How we're different</strong></h2> <p>We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI &amp; Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:</strong>&nbsp;Learn about&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" data-sk="tooltip_parent">our policy</a> for using AI in our application process.</p></div>

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: At Apple, we strive every single day to craft products that enrich people's lives. Our successes are the result of skilled domain experts working in an environment which encourages creativity, collaboration, and re-thinking of old problems in new ways! As a member of the Satellite Connectivity Group, you will work on the satellite network that enables connectivity to iPhone and Watch Ultra when off the grid without cellular or Wi-Fi coverage. Every day, Apple customers use Emergency SOS, Roadside assistance, and Messages via satellite to stay connected when they have no other means to communicate. You will have the unique and rewarding opportunity to shape this and other critical services, to the benefit and safety of millions of Apple device users. The team is seeking a data analyst who will analyze operational data, track the Quality of Experience, and identify problems with the system to ensure an optimal user experience. This person will collaborate closely with multiple teams throughout Apple to influence how we build and operate our system. They will pull and join data from multiple sources, extracting meaningful insights from large, complex datasets to build a complete picture and produce actionable recommendations for improvement. The successful candidate must have a track record of diving deep into data through exploratory data analysis to uncover trends, identify anomalies, and understand the potential causes, drawing on a solid foundation in statistics and a working knowledge of machine learning algorithms. Most importantly, this candidate is a storyteller who excels at pulling multiple threads together into a cohesive and compelling narrative that motivates changes and provides context and insight. This person creates beautiful and informative graphics, animations, and other visual media to communicate their results. A curious, creative, and analytical mind that can see both the big picture and drill down into the details are critical for this role. Description Partner with cross-functional teams to understand the system end-to-end, analyze key metrics, and answer questions about performance and user experience. Mine and synthesize data from multiple sources, applying statistical methods and machine learning techniques to surface trends, anomalies, and actionable insights. Build and maintain data pipelines to support reliable, repeatable analysis. Produce clear, captivating visualizations, dashboards, and reports, tailored to both technical and non-technical audiences. Translate complex findings into simple, compelling narratives that motivate action and drive improvements. Investigate anomalies and performances issues to identify root causes and recommend solutions. Preferred Qualifications Solid understanding of statistical concepts and machine learning algorithms. Familiarity with using AI to improve efficiency. Experience with BI/visualization tools. BS or MS in quantitative field such as data science, statistics, applied mathematics, operations research, engineering, or related discipline. Minimum Qualifications 3+ years experience with data analysis and reporting. Experience synthesizing complex data sources into clear and insightful presentations with an emphasis on the story. Demonstrated experience building analytic tools and analyzing operational data and distilling results into actionable recommendations. Excellent problem-solving skills and independent thinker. Creativity and willingness to explore new solutions and ideas. Excellent data visualization skills. Demonstrated proficiency with scripting languages such as python, R, or MATLAB. Experience with databases and query languages such as SQL. Comfortable working across multiple languages and tools. Excellent written and verbal communication skills and solid teamwork and leadership skills.

jobs.title: Data Engineer-Data Platforms-Google - 3
jobs.description: Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. Your Role And Responsibilities As a seasoned Data Engineer specializing in Google's data platforms, you will design, build, and maintain data engineering solutions on Google's Cloud ecosystem. You will utilize your expertise in Google's services and open-source technologies to deliver scalable and efficient data pipelines. Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include Design Data Pipelines: Design and develop batch and real-time data pipelines for Data Warehouse and Datalake using Google Cloud services such as DataProc, DataFlow, PubSub, BigQuery, and Big Table. Develop Data Engineering Solutions: Build and maintain data engineering solutions using Google Cloud Storage, BigTable, BigQuery DataProc with Spark and Hadoop, Google DataFlow with Apache Beam or Python, and other open-source technologies like Apache Airflow, dbt, Spark/Python, or Spark/Scala. Manage Data Platforms: Schedule and manage the data platform using Google Cloud Scheduler and Cloud Composer (Airflow), ensuring seamless data pipeline operations. Optimize Data Layer: Design and optimize the data layer for efficient data migration and data processing using Google Cloud services. Ensure Scalability: Ensure scalability and efficiency of data pipelines and data engineering solutions to meet business needs. This role can be performed from anywhere in the United States of America Required Technical And Professional Expertise Deep Expertise in Google Data Platforms: Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining data engineering solutions on Google's Cloud ecosystem, including Google DataProc, DataFlow, PubSub, BigQuery, Big Table, Cloud Spanner, CloudSQL, and AlloyDB. Proficiency in Open-Source Technologies: Experience with Apache Beam, Apache Airflow, dbt, Spark/Python, or Spark/Scala, and ability to integrate these technologies with Google Cloud services. Batch and Real-Time Data Pipelines: Experience developing and managing batch and real-time data pipelines for Data Warehouse and Datalake using Google Cloud services. Data Platform Management: Experience scheduling and managing data platforms using Google Cloud Scheduler and Cloud Composer (Airflow). Data Layer Optimization: Experience designing and optimizing data layers for efficient data migration and data processing using Google Cloud services. Preferred Technical And Professional Experience Advanced Apache Beam Knowledge: Experience with Apache Beam, including integrating it with Google Cloud services such as DataFlow, is highly valued. Ability to optimize Beam pipelines for scalability and efficiency is a plus. dbt and Data Modeling: Familiarity with dbt and data modeling concepts, including data warehousing and data lake architecture, is beneficial for designing and optimizing data layers. Spark and Scala Expertise: Proficiency in Spark and Scala, including integrating them with Google Cloud services such as DataProc, is desirable for building and maintaining data engineering solutions.
